title: edta_all_te_ingest_v1 — manifest contract for EDTA all-TE ingest
description: Validates POST /api/actions when type='edta_all_te_ingest'. Resolves an EDTA `*.EDTA.TEanno.gff3(.gz)` from the workspace; the extractor streams it line-by-line and emits a te_hierarchy_v0 envelope (aggregated counts, not per-feature rows — the raw file is too large to materialize).

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the EDTA TEanno GFF3 (plain or .gz).

subject.description: Optional tag for the assembly/haplotype these features describe.

min_length_bp.description: Drop features shorter than this. Default 0 (keep all).

keep_unknown.description: Include features whose classification doesn't map to a known TE class. Default true.
